# @surfaces-ui/discovery

Reference discovery backend: search, profiles, relations and context packs over any DataSource.

The reference discovery backend: keyword and semantic search over tables and columns, profiles, inferred joins and context packs for agents, on any `DataSource`. Data values are withheld unless a source allows them.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/discovery
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
